dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Newton arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Newton has been observed to be fearful and dog reactive. During intake Newton lip lifted when a handler attempted to scan him for a MC. While on leash, Newton is noted to fixate on other dogs and is not easily redirected. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Newton
